sections.desktopBehavior: Split-screen hero: left-aligned headline and CTA share a column; signal orb is a secondary focal point on the 12-column grid.
sections.mobileBehavior: Stack copy before signal orb; CTA remains in normal flow below the lede.

adaptation.details: Signal orb becomes a lower visual beat; all text remains visible without clipping.

sections.justification: The hero must establish the brand and expose its primary work CTA within the first meaningful viewport.

sections.desktopBehavior: Full-width dark transition strip with two-tone marquee and fixed vertical stamp.
sections.mobileBehavior: Ticker keeps a single reading line; stamp becomes a narrow side rail.

adaptation.details: Reduced word scale and narrower stamp preserve the transition without horizontal document overflow.

sections.justification: The strip is a short narrative handoff from the hero into work.

sections.desktopBehavior: 12-column mixed portfolio sequence with wide, split, poster, collision, stack and full-width project compositions.
sections.mobileBehavior: Projects become a single vertical sequence with large touch-friendly previews and visible visit labels.

adaptation.details: Each visual gets its own authored ratio; desktop offsets are removed where they would create detached content or overflow.

sections.justification: The portfolio is the primary proof chapter and requires content-led height to preserve varied project art direction.

sections.desktopBehavior: Three-column studio chapter: side note, editorial statement and interactive capability list.
sections.mobileBehavior: Side note is removed; statement and list become one linear column; capability detail remains reachable by tap.

adaptation.details: The signal orb becomes decorative lower-edge atmosphere while the list keeps semantic order.

sections.justification: Capabilities explain the studio without a generic service-card grid.

sections.desktopBehavior: Cobalt-free contrast chapter on deep paper with an oversized statement and one orb interruption.
sections.mobileBehavior: Statement keeps the same typographic thesis while the orb shifts into the lower corner and copy stays in flow.

adaptation.details: The mobile layout preserves the large word rhythm but reduces the typographic ceiling and decorative orbit footprint.

sections.justification: A purposeful contrast zone gives the page a mid-journey breath and reinforces the studio point of view.

sections.desktopBehavior: Contact-footer fusion over local looping video with strong contrast overlay and complete utility footer.
sections.mobileBehavior: Video uses a centered crop or reduced-motion poster fallback; CTA stacks above the footer links.

adaptation.details: The contact video is decorative and can be removed by reduced-motion preference without removing content or action.

sections.justification: The final contact chapter is the narrative climax and remains understandable with the poster fallback.
